changes: First library release for Analog Rytm MKII OS 1.74, on core-ar2 0.3, approved by the owner on 24 October 2026. Keeps sample loops in time with the project tempo by repitching them.

Source-only export compiled from sdk/analog-rytm-mkii/modules/loop-sync in Modwerk's pinned toolchain (m68k-elf GCC 16.2.0, binutils 2.47) with the shared SDK's analog-rytm-mk2/store.h. Not byte-identical to the author's emulator-tested LS18 build (GCC 12.2); the released package has not run in the emulator or on a unit.
stockPolicy: No firmware or stock-derived code/tables are present. Addresses, lengths and SHA-256 guards are metadata; exported instructions and sections are authored module code. Local materialized recipes and firmware are never committed.
